summary: Adds a DB-bound terminal staging repair sweeper so stale committed .part files and .part.chunks receipts can be removed only after durable checkpoint, live source, live destination, and receipt-key evidence agree.
audit_findings: Rev0680 correctly rejected stale committed staging artifacts but left recovery to external callers.
A restart path needs an executable repair primitive that is narrower than generic staging cleanup and stronger than deleting whatever appears under staging_root_path.
Receipt files can be safely recognized without reconstructing full manifest lineage by hashing their bytes back to the persisted sync-chunk-receipt:v1 idempotency key.
repair_checks: repair_sync_session_checkpoint_staging_artifacts first loads the checkpoint resume view with durable/source/destination proof required and staging cleanliness disabled only as an advisory pre-check.
The SQLite checkpoint database is opened read-only and must stay outside source, destination, and staging roots.
Repair candidates must be materialized file results that are already committed-cleaned and joined to apply intents and persisted source manifest entry digests.
The destination target is rehashed and must match checkpointed remote size/hash evidence before any staging artifact is removed.
A stale staged file is removed only if it is regular, non-symlinked, and byte-identical to checkpointed remote content.
A stale receipt file is removed only if its digest-derived path matches a committed chunk row and its bytes hash to the persisted receipt idempotency key.
Receipt directories are removed only if expected receipt cleanup leaves them empty; unexpected artifacts fail closed.
The strict resume view is reloaded after repair to prove post_repair_staging_artifacts_clean.
